headline: PMA Announces Nationwide Strike Against FBR's Alleged Harassment and Tax Policies | Express News
summary: The Private Medical Association announced a nationwide strike against alleged harassment and tax policies by the Federal Board of Revenue. It called imposing the POS system on private hospitals unacceptable.
why: The Federal Board of Revenue is Pakistan's tax authority, and disputes over tax enforcement affect private healthcare providers and fiscal revenue collection.
